hook: No engine power, no go-around, one try at the runway.
narration: This space shuttle had no engine power to land, and exactly one try at the runway.
Shuttles came home as gliders. If the approach went wrong, there was no going around.
Here, Discovery brings seven astronauts home after fifteen days and more than six million miles.
Crews called the shuttle a flying brick. It dropped on a glide slope seven times steeper and twenty times faster than an airliner.
[short pause] The landing gear came down just fifteen seconds before touchdown.
Crosswinds pushed it around as the wheels hit the runway.
Tire smoke caught in the wingtip vortices and spun into a sideways tornado.
Then a drag chute opened in stages, so the speed would not rip it off right away.
outcome: Discovery made it down on its one and only try, and all seven astronauts were home.
title: Landing the space shuttle with no power
description:
NASA engineering film of space shuttle landings at Kennedy Space Center, Florida: Atlantis returning from STS-122 and Discovery returning from STS-131 on April 20, 2010, gliding in without power for a single shot at the runway.

Footage: NASA GRC video, via the NASA Image and Video Library: https://images.nasa.gov/details/GRC-2023-CM-0249
